# TableCheck

> > TableCheck is a leading restaurant reservation and management platform serving Japan and Asia-Pacific, offering solutions for dining reservations, payment processing, no-show prevention, and guest experience optimization.

Founded by CEO Yuu Taniguchi (谷口優), TableCheck (formerly TableSolution/VESPER) provides comprehensive hospitality technology including TableCheck Pay, FastPass skip-the-line dining, CRM tools, and integrations with platforms like Ctrip. The company played a significant role in supporting restaurants during COVID-19 with emergency relief programs.

## Key Topics

- TableCheck reservation management system
- TableCheck Pay payment processing
- FastPass no-wait dining
- No-show prevention and cancellation protection
- Restaurant CRM and guest management
- COVID-19 restaurant support initiatives
- Ctrip integration for China inbound reservations
- Gourmet site survey and consumer insights
- VESPER legacy platform
- Yuu Taniguchi (谷口優) CEO
- Hotel and fine dining partnerships
- Japan restaurant digitalization
- Takeout and delivery solutions
- Go To Eat campaign integration
